question: Fill in the blank (2) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**address**" means to speak to or deal with a particular issue. (समाधान करना)
 
• In the context of climate change, it is necessary to actively deal with or address the causes, rather than merely discussing or elaborating on them.
 
• The other options: "**evade**," "**elaborate**," and "**overlook**" do not fit the context as they imply either avoidance, excessive detail, or neglect.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** It is crucial to address__ the causes of climate change, which primarily result from human activities such as the burning of fossil fuels, deforestation, and industrial processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Evade (टालना)**: means to avoid dealing with something.
 
• **Elaborate (विस्तृत विवरण देना)**: means to explain in more detail.
 
• **Overlook (अनदेखा करना)**: means to fail to notice something.
